- Initial launch of digital-product-launch-coach, an end-to-end coaching tool for creators selling digital products.
- Supports validation, pricing, storefront/platform choice, launch and traffic strategy, refund and piracy defense, upsell/ladder design, and scaling to recurring revenue.
- Compatible with major storefronts: Stan Store, Beacons, Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, Sellfy, Ko-fi, Payhip, Whop, Etsy-digital, and others.
